claim: Gate synthesis recovers compact local Boolean structure
required_evidence: Full truth-table accuracy and expression size across held-out combinations
limitation: Synthetic finite predicate only

claim: Compiled bit operations reduce resource use
required_evidence: Timing and explicit-buffer accounting with unpacked versus packed inputs
limitation: CPU/NumPy prototype not hardware PPA

claim: Bounded learners can recover variables operators and relation-type topology beyond a fixed AND rule
required_evidence: Five-seed multi-rule distractor composition and task-only reachability experiments
limitation: Finite candidate library and synthetic topology vocabulary

claim: MCR2 rate reduction is measurable but not identical to literal bit or gate complexity
required_evidence: Five-seed objective flow plus entropy distortion sparsity and synthesized-gate accounting
limitation: Controlled NumPy proxy not full ReduNet or CRATE

claim: Discrete rate reduction is an operational prefix-code saving rather than a language-free Boolean entropy
required_evidence: Kraft checks side-information controls basis-change controls and routed fallback
limitation: Code lengths remain conditional on a public meta-language and dimensions

claim: Exact small-function synthesis separates balanced parity from the balanced Boolean population under a fixed formula basis
required_evidence: Complete four-input formula catalog and balanced-function gate histogram
limitation: Minimum formula tree only; not minimum DAG or hardware cost

claim: Multi-language Circuit-MDL routes structured rules to compact languages and usually sends sampled balanced random-LUT controls to the raw route
required_evidence: Exact function codes plus model and residual task codes across ANF threshold ROBDD formula and raw routes
limitation: All ten 6-input controls use RawLabels but 4-input samples contain accidental ANF or literal-plus-residual exceptions; route grammar is fixed before data; selection is not a per-instance circuit lower bound

claim: Fixed and paid AIG/XAG/MIG-style formula bases exhibit task-dependent formula complexity and retained-witness code differences on the complete three-input function space
required_evidence: Exact 256-by-4 formula oracle paid basis tags witness code upper bounds and full-truth-table Boolean diagnostics
limitation: Exact only for formulas; free constants and complemented edges; tie-inclusive primitive counts; MAJ3 and binary gates are not PPA-equivalent; diagnostics are not a learned router

claim: The external Hard-LGN audit selects multiple hardening candidate classes and preserves task-input hard accuracy after ABC on all evaluated synthesis rows
required_evidence: Validation-selected hardening rows held-out truth-refit comparisons and ABC task-input reevaluation
limitation: External commit and not a symbolic_logic rerun; source environment absent; correlated evaluated rows; no SAT full-domain equivalence; pre-BLIF nodes and post-AIG ANDs are not like-for-like PPA

claim: A paid hierarchical representation-and-basis prior with separately accounted residual raw escape and runtime fallback is the best-supported next-stage inductive-bias hypothesis
required_evidence: Partial-data joint routing basis ablations approximate residual search abstention distribution shift and full code/latency/PPA accounting
limitation: Not yet one serialized payload or learned end-to-end router

claim: Oracle local gate plus BFS handles longer paths than fixed-depth circuit
required_evidence: Reachability accuracy by path length
limitation: BFS is hand-coded symbolic solver and local rule is oracle

claim: Boolean composition propagates grounding error and hardening discards probability calibration
required_evidence: Brier score and accuracy across uncertainty/noise levels plus corrupted-gridworld task accuracy
limitation: Independent Bernoulli local-noise control and synthetic correlated visual corruption; local hard/soft classification accuracy is equal at matched bit-flip rate

claim: Logic gates do not imply universal symbolic reasoning
required_evidence: Fixed-depth counterexample and report limitations
limitation: Does not cover all solver families

claim: Learned soft gates can be hardened and connected to a symbolic BFS in the controlled local-rule setting
required_evidence: Soft-vs-hardened local OOD metrics and learned-gate BFS results
limitation: Fixed wiring and synthetic clean predicates; no perceptual end-to-end guarantee

claim: State transitions extend gate computation to variable-length cyclic traversal
required_evidence: Fixed-K versus loop-until-fixed-point accuracy and query timing
limitation: Finite state and memory remain necessary; not a universal proof or planner engine

claim: Random-LUT generalization failure parity compilation-search failure and probability marginalization are distinct gate-compilation boundaries
required_evidence: Random-LUT/parity scaling constructive XAG parity upper bound and exact-versus-hard probability results
limitation: Parity has an adequate XOR basis and depth but is not recovered by bounded GateBeam; the precise beam/ranking failure mechanism is not identified; sampled random LUTs have no proved per-instance lower bound; general WMC remains unmeasured

claim: Looped frontier control recovers bounded monotone planning/proof search beyond fixed K
required_evidence: Planning frontier accuracy and expansion/time results
limitation: Proxy is not a complete planner or SAT/SMT solver

claim: Raw rendered pixels can be grounded into named predicates and composed with a learned gate and symbolic solver in a complete gridworld inference pipeline
required_evidence: Task accuracy calibration grounding localization fallback and latency across clean correlated corruption and size OOD
limitation: Component-supervised synthetic visual task with fixed four-neighbor topology and BFS
